notes.title: Markiplier 80% Off Thank You Sale Is Almost Over Plus New Boss Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38655028/a49e06e34c530612f8c5e54c0dd4322dc3180dd3.png[/img]

Prepare for trouble!  Enemy boss has been sighted up ahead!  Use your wits and missiles to defeat them and continue on your path ahead!

[list]
[*]New Boss
[*]Improved Gameplay Loop
[*]Shield Powerups To Collect
[*]New Music From Deceased Superior Technician Plus Additional SFX 
[*]LAZORS
[*]Max Score Is Increased
[/list]

The game will go on sale again for cheap, but if you want to try fighting the boss this is a good opportunity!
